messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected on service=inference-gateway region=us-west-2 metric=5xx_rate window=1m value=11.8% threshold=1.0% — pagerduty triggered

pagerduty: AUTO-PAGE -> on-call: @maria (rotation: infra-sre-night) — incident PID#1765437890. Escalation policy: 5m->sms->call.

maria: ack'd. reading graphs now — starting triage. any traffic slicing in place?

sam: seeing same. 5xx sources look like upstream 502/504 and some 500 from model-workers. Rolling average jumped at 05:04 UTC.

maria: good, thanks. Maria: quick customer impact note: partial requests failing; retry rate up; some user sessions report slow completions. ETA on blast radius?

sam: most traffic to inference-gateway-usw2. Canary and eu routes unaffected. Approx 22% of requests to the global endpoints touched usw2.

tony: logs show a spike in kv-cache miss + TLS renegotiation errors from a subset of sidecars. sample: 
```
2026-03-15T05:03:58Z gateway: upstream(10.2.3.11): 502 Bad Gateway, backend="model-worker-03" trace=abc123
2026-03-15T05:04:01Z sidecar: kvcache miss, fallback to model rps=120
```

leo: interesting — we recently changed keepalive settings in the nodepool last deploy. shipping team, any deploys 05:00-05:10?

maria: checking deploys... none in prod in that window according to deploy-bot.

sam: confirming: no deploys. autoscaler did bounce a few pods at 04:55 for a spot reclaim, but scaled back. could be connection churn.

maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) route new traffic away from usw2 to eu1/usw1 (slice 70/30) 2) bump model-worker pool min replicas by +30% 3) disable auto-rollouts 4) warm cache for top customers. executing now.

sam: executing route override — pushing traffic-slice policy: 
```json
{ "routes": {"usw2": 30, "eu1": 50, "usw1": 20} }
```

maria: applied. Confirming global LB shows drop in new sessions to usw2.

pagerduty: NOTE: page still open; next escalation in 6 minutes if unacked.

tony: scaling model-workers in usw2: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-worker --replicas=26` — pod churn starting.

leo: rolling restart of sidecar proxies in the affected pool to clear stuck connections: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/sidecar-proxy-usw2`

maria: adding a temporary retry-header to reduce immediate load: set X-Client-Retry: no for downstream clients via config.

sam: observed 5xx rate drop from 11.8% -> 4.3% after slice + scale. still above threshold.

maria: ok keep rolling. Tony, any signs of degraded infra (disk, CPU, network)?

tony: no CPU spike. network error counts correlate with TLS renegotiation logs — likely upstream connection limits. opening ticket to infra-nic team.

maria: timeframe — if rate <1% in next 15m we'll start gradual traffic restore and avoid customer impact. If not, fallback to model-variant serving (lighter quantized) for usw2 to reduce backend latency.

leo: runbook note: runbook section "gateway-502-spike" steps 1-5 followed. tagging for postmortem.

sre-runbook-bot: Added annotation: incident:1765437890, runbook:gateway-502-spike, responders:[maria,sam,tony,leo], priority:high.

maria: handoff: @sam, I'm going offline in 40m for rotation change — if we persist above 2% please escalate to infra lead @tony. Leaving notes in thread.

sam: taking primary. I'll monitor and coordinate with infra. Quick check: customers with >5% error rate: acme-corp, beta-ai, search-saas. Reaching out to success for notifications.

maria: thanks. I'm posting a brief customer impact to #support-alerts with the partial outage note and mitigations.

pagerduty: Escalation suppressed by ack. Reminder: do not silence until triage complete.

sam: current numbers: 5xx=0.9% over 1m window, 0.3% over 5m — looks trending down. keeping traffic at sliced levels for 20m to stabilize.

tony: infra team investigating TLS renegotiation thresholds. Possible upstream LB config bug. If confirmed we'll set connection pool limits higher and enable sticky connections temporarily.

leo: taking followup action: create a short eval to reproduce high-concurrency KV cache misses in staging. filing GH issue infra/gw#452.

maria: prelim customer impact summary: ~3% of global requests saw transient 5xx errors concentrated in us-west-2 between 05:03-05:20 UTC. No data loss. Some degraded latency for heavy requests. Notifying enterprise customers.

sam: marking for postmortem and RCA. timeline + mitigations will be documented.

maria: resolved for now. leaving thread for handoff. please ping if regressions. :white_check_mark:

sre-runbook-bot: Incident 1765437890 moved to status: monitoring. Postmortem owner: leo.

sam: ack and closing pager. thanks team. :thumbsup:
